about: Interface strings, area a (see notes/sa-ui.md). OWNER: ui-a.

models.source: MW kANDa m. n. 'a section, chapter, division of a work (e.g. of the Rāmāyaṇa)'

title.tagline.en: A retro RPG where Rāmāyaṇa ślokas power every move

title.howto1.en: Walk with the arrow keys or the on-screen pad; press A (Z / Enter) to talk.
title.howto1.ctx: title / new journey: how to play 1 (manifest.howToPlay[0])

title.howto2.en: Listen to each śloka in its story; tap any word to see its meaning.
title.howto2.sa: कथायां श्लोकान् शृणु। अर्थं ज्ञातुं शब्दं स्पृश।

title.howto3.en: In battle, astras draw on real ślokas: in a Story journey recite a line of the verse; in Practice answer a Sanskrit question.
title.howto3.sa: युद्धे अस्त्राणि श्लोकेभ्यः बलं लभन्ते। कथायां श्लोकस्य पादं पठ। अभ्यासे प्रश्नस्य उत्तरं देहि।

title.howto4.en: Rest at āśrama shrines to recite verses, restore them and unlock new astras.
title.howto4.sa: आश्रमस्य मन्दिरे विश्राम्य। तत्र श्लोकान् पठ, पूर्णान् कुरु च। ततः नूतनानि अस्त्राणि लभस्व।

title.firstVerse.ctx: title screen: caption under the first verse, after its reference

title.continue.ctx: title screen: continue the saved journey (save slot heading)

title.playH.ctx: save slot: play time, hours and minutes

title.restored.ctx: save slot: how many verses are restored

title.replaceWarn.en: Starting again replaces your saved journey.
title.replaceWarn.sa: पुनः आरभसे चेत्, रक्षिता यात्रा नश्यति।
title.replaceWarn.ctx: title screen: confirm before a new journey replaces the save

title.restart.ctx: button: start a new journey (replaces the save)

title.keys.en: Keyboard: arrows move · Z / Enter confirm · X back · M menu
title.keys.ctx: title screen keyboard hint (Sanskrit is shown with the key caps by the view)

newGame.name.ctx: new journey: label of the name field

newGame.intro.en: You are a young student at the sage's hermitage by the river. The verses of the newly told epic have been scattered by an illusion: walk into the story, hear each verse where it was first spoken, and restore it.
newGame.intro.sa: त्वं नद्याः तीरे ऋषेः आश्रमे {g:शिष्यः|शिष्या} असि। मायया श्लोकाः विक्षिप्ताः। कथां प्रविश। यत्र श्लोकः उक्तः, तत्र तं शृणु। ततः तं पूर्णं कुरु।

newGame.back.ctx: new journey: back to the title screen

newGame.notReady.en: The journey could not begin yet (content is still loading).
newGame.notReady.sa: यात्रा अद्य अपि न आरब्धा। किञ्चित् तिष्ठ, पुनः प्रयतस्व।

newGame.defaultName.ctx: the default player name (kept as English 'Shishya' in the save; shown as शिष्यः / शिष्या)

lang.storyText.ctx: label of the dialogue-language picker (new journey, settings)

lang.note.en: Simple spoken Sanskrit (Level 1–3). Tap ▶ as usual.

hud.explore.ctx: objective line when there is no objective

hud.keys.en: Arrows / WASD move · hold X to run · Z or Enter talk · M menu
hud.keys.ctx: explore keyboard hint (Sanskrit is shown with the key caps by the view)

hud.kOk.ctx: keyboard hint part: Z / Enter (title screen)

hud.error.en: Something went wrong; please try again.
hud.error.sa: कार्यं सम्यक् न अभवत्। पुनः प्रयतस्व।

hud.label.ctx: platform top bar: book and verses restored

hud.resolve.ctx: battle info box (debate): the conviction bar, like HP

hud.book.ctx: a book (kāṇḍa) by number, when its name is missing

say.newWord.ctx: heading over one new word card

chapter.doneNote.en: Your journey is saved. Rest now; the next book awaits when you return.
chapter.doneNote.sa: तव यात्रा रक्षिता। अधुना विश्राम्य। यदा पुनः आगच्छसि, तदा नूतनं काण्डम् आरभस्व।

chapter.results.ctx: button: end the session and see the results

shop.owned.ctx: shop row: how many you carry

shrine.reciteSub.en: Restore a verse you have heard

shrine.reciteHead.en: Recite a verse to restore it

shrine.noneHeard.en: You have not heard any verses yet.
shrine.noneHeard.sa: त्वया अद्य अपि श्लोकः न श्रुतः।

end.thanks.en: Thank you, {player}. The verses you restored live again in the sage's book of verses.
end.thanks.sa: धन्यवादः, {player}। त्वया पूर्णाः कृताः श्लोकाः पुनः ऋषेः ग्रन्थे जीवन्ति।

end.restored.ctx: ending screen: heading over the restored verses

end.credit1.en: Verses: Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa (sources listed per verse in PRD.md and REVIEW.md)

end.credit2.en: Pixel art and chiptune: original, made for Samskuru
end.credit2.sa: चित्राणि गीतानि च: नूतनानि, अत्र एव कृतानि

menu.title.ctx: menu button and menu sheet title (a bag, as in a retro RPG)

menu.restConfirm.ctx: menu button: confirm end of session

menu.restNote.en: Your journey is saved; continue it next time from the title screen.
menu.restNote.sa: तव यात्रा रक्षिता। पुनः आगत्य अग्रे गच्छ।
menu.restNote.ctx: menu: note under the end-session button

menu.saved.ctx: toast / status: the journey was saved

party.full.en: All 4 slots are full: tap an equipped move to remove it first.
party.full.sa: स्थानं न अस्ति। प्रथमम् एकं मन्त्रं त्यज।

party.moveMeta.ctx: party: a move's element, challenge kind and PP

words.none.sa: अत्र अद्य अपि शब्दाः न सन्ति।

words.unseen.ctx: aria: a word not seen yet

items.useOn.ctx: items: pick a hero to use the item on

items.none.en: No items yet. Market stalls sell fruit, honey and herbs.
items.none.sa: अद्य अपि वस्तूनि न सन्ति। आपणे फलानि, मधु, ओषधयः च सन्ति।

settings.soundOff.en: Sound is off in your Samskuru settings
settings.soundOff.ctx: settings: sound is off in the platform

settings.note.en: Script (Devanagari or Roman), sound and reduced motion follow your Samskuru profile settings.
settings.note.ctx: settings: what is set in the platform profile
